explanation.replay_request_record_ids: CP17-0 adds each target's serve states to the material key stored in the request records, so their record ids change; every count, event, reason, document, forecast id and record id of the replay documents is equal (REAL_EXPORT_REPLAY.json has no non-volatile difference)
explanation.theses_table_hashes_and_snapshot_hashes: each thesis row stores report_path, which names the run's output folder (rec_smoke at 3d2089b, cp0_smoke at the CP17-0 code); inside one smoke run base_off, frozen_off and frozen_on tables are equal (lab_tables_equal_base_off_frozen_off_frozen_on true in both runs); so snapshot hashes, forecast ids and record ids of the scout examples and the analyze line differ between the two runs
explanation.volatile: capture times, pass ids, pass record ids, measured latency, wall time and file hashes that include them
